# GetFalloff

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [3D Sound](Blitz3D-3D-Sound)

</div>


```blitzbasic
GetFalloff:Int32
```

**Returns:** `0` for the curve of this runtime, `1` for the curve of the original and `2` for the curve of SoLoud.

## Description

Tells the curve that new 3D sounds start with. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print GetFalloff()
```
